objective: Determine which mask pairs or strategies can improve the common midpoint on 31 edges, with precise scope, and compare the best surviving bound for growing paths.
status: Proved: On 31 adjacent products the common midpoint requires exactly 512 leaves and depth nine under arbitrary adaptive visible affine questions, and 512 is the optimum across all common masks. A rank criterion gives the same lower bound when all four partial checksums have half-rank at least eight, even for unequal choices.
title: Test the midpoint and alternative sketch strategies
